rows.claim: The accuracy retro's owed instrument now exists: changed prose records are byte-checked at pre-push for missing paths, empty or out-of-bounds anchors, claim-token misses, and numbers absent from every named source in their sentence, so a phantom citation can no longer ride a landed record for days unseen.
rows.quote: a tools/citation_lint.py wired into the pre-push hook would make it machine-enforced
rows.steal: Any seat writing a doctrine/receipt/run story lands it through the pre-push gate; on a finding, fix the citation, downgrade the claim, or accept by name in configs/citation_lint_baseline.json (zero rows day one).
rows.falsifier: A pushed record that keeps a phantom citation past its landing: any seat can re-run tools/citation_lint.py check --files <record> and reproduce the fire; silence on a known phantom kills the law.

rows.law: founding fixtures are embedded, never live-read
rows.claim: The 191.8M founding fixture is embedded verbatim in the test file because the errata striking it from STORY.md landed mid-flight; the fixture survives the errata and the live demo separately proves the gate catches what the live file now carries (the untraced 46,531).
rows.quote: the clause "191.8M tokens spent" that stood here is STRUCK; its named source DIGEST.md has zero "191" hits
rows.steal: When a test fixture names a living record, embed the bytes at build time and note the live path; a sibling lane's fix to the record must never break your gate's founding proof.
rows.falsifier: A fixture that must be re-derived from a living file after every edit to that file means the embedding law was skipped; the STORY errata landing mid-build without breaking this lane's tests is the passing observation.

rows.law: gates-live-but-unarmed closes only with precision data, not intent
rows.claim: The lint's first whole-record runs manufactured 3,805 fires on the shared tree; the gate only became usable by paying for every cut with a named live false-fire class (file-size measurements, co-sentential code paths, id lists, line refs, untracked sibling work logs, census counts) and by splitting enforcement certainty: deterministic classes block, heuristics warn.
rows.quote: Phantom-number sources are RECORDS (digests, receipts, ledgers): the class the register names is "its named source has zero '191' hits"
rows.steal: Before wiring any new detector as enforcing, run it over the shared tree's changed set first, classify every fire, and split the exit by class certainty; a gate that fires 3,805 times trains operators to dismiss it.
rows.falsifier: A future push blocked on a finding an author cannot trace to a real defect means the certainty split regressed; every blocking finding must be either fixable or baseline-able by name in one sitting.
